html:
Refer a Nurse in Canada. Earn Up to $700

Know a great nurse? Help them discover travel healthcare and get rewarded.

At Goodwill Staffing & Recruitment, great nurses know great nurses.
When you refer someone to join our travel healthcare team, you can earn up to $700 for each successful referral. It’s easy, flexible, and rewarding. Refer a nurse with 2 years of Canadian nursing experience and earn a bonus.

Bonus Breakdown

Earn $500

For each successful referral of a qualified clinician.

Earn $700

For each successful referral of a bilingual (English & French) clinician.

Who Can You Refer

We’re hiring travel healthcare professionals across Canada:

  • Registered Nurses (RNs)

  • Licensed Practical Nurses (LPNs / RPNs)

  • Nurse Practitioners (NPs)

  • Personal Support Workers (PSWs)

  • Allied Health Professionals (PTs, RTs, and more)

They don’t need to be travel nurses yet—just open to the idea of working across provinces.  You can always share our blog  What is a Travel Nurse? to get them excited!

How It Works

  • Step 1 Reach out to a friend who’d be a great fit
  • Step 2 Share our Job Board with current openings.
  • Step 3 Ask for their permission to refer them.
  • Step 4 Email our Recruiters at careers@goodwillstaffing.ca with their name & contact info.
  • Once they’re hired and completed 31 shifts you can redeem your bonus.

Why Refer to Goodwill Staffing?

We've Got Your Friends Covered:

  • Travel & logistics support

  • License reimbursement

  • Contracts across BC, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario, New Brunswick, PEI & more

  • Focus on work-life balance

  • A growing community of amazing travel nurses

Check out the details on travel and license information at Health Canada – License & Travel Information

What Our Nurses Say

“Goodwill Staffing are very reliable, honest, and operate with integrity. My experience with them has been awesome!”

Dece R., Travel Nurse

Brief Referral Bonus Terms

🎯 Bonus paid after 31 completed shifts

📋 Referred nurses must meet hiring criteria

💸 Paid via e-transfer

📅 Terms & conditions subject to change

 For full details, ask your recruiter about the Goodwill Staffing Referral Program.

📣 Ready to Refer?

Email your referral to:
📧 careers@goodwillstaffing.ca

Have questions? Send us a message; we’d love to hear from you!
